title: Build a Production-Ready App
description: Generates a complete architecture and implementation plan for a scalable application.
prompt_text: Act as a senior software architect. Design a production-ready [insert app type] using [insert language/framework]. Provide project structure, database schema, API endpoints, authentication flow, security practices, scalability considerations, deployment strategy, and sample code snippets. Explain every major component and recommend industry best practices.

title: Code Review Expert
description: Performs a professional code review with optimization suggestions.
prompt_text:
Act as a senior software engineer and perform a professional code review on the following code:

[paste code]

Identify bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, maintainability concerns, and code smells. Suggest optimized code with explanations and provide a severity rating for each issue.

title: Bug Hunter & Fix Generator
description: Finds root causes of errors and provides fixes.
prompt_text:
Act as an expert debugger. Analyze the following error message and code:

[insert error]

[insert code]

Determine the root cause, explain why it occurs, provide corrected code, suggest preventive measures, and list debugging steps for future troubleshooting.

title: Full-Stack Feature Builder
description: Creates complete implementation plans for app features.
prompt_text: Act as a full-stack developer. Build a complete implementation plan for the feature: [insert feature]. Include frontend UI logic, backend API design, database tables, validation rules, security checks, edge cases, testing strategy, and deployment considerations.

title: Database Schema Designer
prompt_text: Act as a database architect. Design an optimized database schema for [insert application]. Include tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, normalization recommendations, scalability considerations, and SQL CREATE TABLE statements.

title: API Documentation Generator
prompt_text:
Act as a technical writer. Generate professional API documentation for the following endpoints:

[insert endpoints]

Include request examples, response examples, authentication requirements, error handling, status codes, and implementation notes.

title: Learning Roadmap Creator
description: Builds a structured learning path for any technology.
prompt_text: Act as a technology mentor. Create a 90-day learning roadmap for mastering [insert technology]. Break it into weekly milestones, projects, resources, practice exercises, interview questions, and portfolio-building activities.

title: Algorithm Optimization Expert
prompt_text:
Act as a competitive programming expert. Analyze the following algorithm:

[paste code]

Evaluate time complexity, space complexity, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities. Provide an improved solution and explain the trade-offs.

title: Capacitor Mobile App Generator
description: Creates complete mobile app architecture using web technologies.
prompt_text: Act as a senior hybrid mobile app developer. Design a production-ready Capacitor application for [insert app idea]. Include HTML/CSS/JS structure, offline support, push notifications, local storage, monetization options, security recommendations, and deployment instructions.

title: Technical Interview Simulator
prompt_text: Act as a senior technical interviewer for a [insert role] position. Conduct a realistic interview with increasing difficulty. Ask coding, system design, behavioral, and problem-solving questions. Evaluate answers and provide detailed feedback after each response.

title: 30-Day Content Calendar
description: Creates a complete social media content plan.
prompt_text: Act as a social media strategist. Create a 30-day content calendar for [insert niche]. Include post ideas, hooks, captions, content formats, hashtags, engagement tactics, posting schedule, and CTAs optimized for maximum reach.

title: Viral Instagram Reels Machine
prompt_text: Act as an Instagram growth expert. Generate 20 viral Reels ideas for [insert niche]. For each idea, provide a hook, script outline, visual instructions, caption, CTA, and reason why it can go viral.

title: LinkedIn Authority Builder
description: Creates professional LinkedIn content that attracts opportunities.
prompt_text: Act as a LinkedIn personal branding expert. Create 10 high-engagement LinkedIn posts for [insert industry]. Use storytelling, authority-building techniques, strong hooks, value-driven insights, and engagement-focused CTAs.

title: Facebook Ads Campaign Architect
description: Builds complete ad campaigns from scratch.
prompt_text: Act as a performance marketing specialist. Create a Facebook Ads campaign for [insert product/service]. Include audience targeting, creatives, ad copy, headlines, budget allocation, funnel strategy, KPIs, and optimization recommendations.

title: High-Converting Lead Magnet
prompt_text: Act as a lead generation expert. Design a lead magnet for [insert niche]. Include title, value proposition, content outline, landing page copy, email follow-up sequence, and conversion optimization tactics.

title: YouTube Growth Blueprint
description: Builds a growth strategy for YouTube channels.
prompt_text: Act as a YouTube strategist. Create a growth plan for a channel in [insert niche]. Include content pillars, video ideas, thumbnail concepts, title formulas, SEO recommendations, upload schedule, and monetization strategy.

title: Influencer Outreach Generator
prompt_text: Act as an influencer marketing manager. Create a complete influencer outreach campaign for [insert brand]. Include outreach messages, collaboration ideas, negotiation strategies, campaign structure, KPIs, and reporting templates.

title: Product Launch Planner
description: Designs launch campaigns that maximize visibility.
prompt_text: Act as a product launch strategist. Create a launch campaign for [insert product]. Include pre-launch, launch-day, and post-launch strategies, content ideas, email sequences, partnerships, ads, and engagement tactics.

title: Personal Brand Accelerator
description: Builds a powerful personal branding strategy.
prompt_text: Act as a personal branding expert. Create a complete personal branding roadmap for [insert profession]. Include positioning, content themes, authority-building tactics, networking strategy, and platform-specific growth recommendations.

title: TikTok Viral Content Creator
description: Generates viral TikTok content ideas and scripts.
prompt_text: Act as a TikTok growth consultant. Generate 25 viral TikTok content ideas for [insert niche]. Include hooks, scripts, visuals, trends to leverage, captions, hashtags, and audience engagement tactics.

title: Sales Page Conversion Master
description: Writes persuasive sales pages that drive conversions.
prompt_text: Act as a world-class direct response copywriter. Write a high-converting sales page for [insert product/service]. Include headline, subheadline, problem agitation, solution, benefits, social proof, objections handling, FAQs, and strong CTAs.

title: SEO Blog Writer
prompt_text: Act as an SEO content strategist. Write a comprehensive blog article about [insert topic]. Include keyword optimization, engaging introduction, H2/H3 structure, examples, FAQs, and a compelling conclusion.

title: Cold Email Generator
description: Creates personalized cold emails that get replies.
prompt_text: Act as a B2B sales copywriter. Write a personalized cold email for [insert target audience] promoting [insert offer]. Focus on relevance, value, brevity, curiosity, and strong reply rates.

title: Email Sequence Builder
prompt_text: Act as an email marketing expert. Create a 7-email sequence for [insert product/service]. Include welcome email, trust-building emails, value-driven content, objection handling, urgency emails, and conversion-focused CTAs.

title: Storytelling Content Creator
prompt_text:
Act as a professional storyteller. Turn the following idea into a compelling story:

[insert idea]

Use emotional hooks, conflict, transformation, memorable lessons, and audience engagement techniques.

title: Landing Page Copy Expert
prompt_text: Act as a conversion copywriter. Write landing page copy for [insert offer]. Include attention-grabbing headlines, benefits, trust elements, testimonials, FAQs, and persuasive CTAs.

title: Video Script Generator
description: Creates professional scripts for video content.
prompt_text: Act as a video content strategist. Write a complete script for a [insert platform] video about [insert topic]. Include opening hook, pacing instructions, storytelling elements, engagement triggers, and CTA.

title: Case Study Writer
prompt_text: Act as a case study specialist. Write a professional case study for [insert business]. Include challenge, solution, implementation process, measurable results, testimonials, and business impact.

title: Product Description Optimizer
prompt_text: Act as an eCommerce copywriter. Write a compelling product description for [insert product]. Highlight benefits, emotional triggers, unique selling points, objections handling, and conversion-focused messaging.

title: Authority Article Creator
prompt_text: Act as an industry thought leader. Write a long-form authority article on [insert topic]. Include original insights, frameworks, examples, data-backed arguments, and actionable recommendations.
